resources.string: Choose the interface language. Changes apply immediately and are kept for the next launch.
Replay the main feature tour at any time. Turning off automatic prompts never disables manual replay.
Library / shelves / recommendations / visual style / connections / settings
Welcome to the new Pica Library
Take a minute to see the library, recommendations, connections and settings. You can skip the tour at any time. Later, replay it from Settings → Help & Onboarding.
You can replay this tour later from Settings → Help & Onboarding.
Your Pica, E-H, local downloads and remote copies are organized here.
Recommendations use long-term interests, recent behavior, explicit preferences and current-session intent.
Browse Pica, E-Hentai and ExHentai when the corresponding source is available.
Language, recommendations, connections, storage, updates and help are managed here.
Inspect your profile, tune preferences on a 0–10 scale, and enable or disable visual-style recommendations independently.
After LAN pairing, your phone can read comics already downloaded on Desktop without downloading another copy.
Switch between Simplified Chinese, 日本語 and English. Changes are saved immediately.
Check and install formal Android updates here.
Replay this feature tour at any time, even when automatic prompts are disabled.

Open Shelves to create and manage collections. In Library or a shelf, long-press a comic to enter selection mode; you can select all, clear selection, add items to a shelf, remove them from the current shelf, or unfavorite them.
Refresh checks Desktop, favorites, shelves and remote storage with visible phases. Normal favorite checks reconcile recent changes first and only fall back to a full scan when needed.

Use this button to generate or intentionally rebuild the phone-local recommendation cycle. Each cycle is split into 12-item batches; switching batches reuses the current cycle instead of rebuilding it.
Open here to inspect why recommendations are being made, tune explicit preferences, sync portable recommendation state, and control visual-style influence.
See long-term interests, recent behavior, this phone session and the current recommendation composition before changing any controls.
Tune authors, IPs, tags, categories and visual families from 0–10. 5 is neutral; you can also block a target or mark it as “want this now” for the current phone session.
Desktop and phone keep independent live recommendation cycles. Sync merges durable preferences, feedback and portable foundations; true preference conflicts are shown for you to resolve.
Choose Off, analysis-only, or live ranking. The phone consumes lightweight visual affinity computed from the Desktop foundation; it does not run the full visual model itself.
Choose how strongly visual similarity affects ranking. This changes the visual contribution without replacing your normal author, tag, recent and session preferences.
That covers the main features. This tour remains available in Settings.
